body_markdown:
****


**SALT LAKE CITY — November 19, 2026 — ReposiTrak, Inc. (NYSE: TRAK)** , the leader in retail supply chain, merchandising, compliance and traceability solutions, today announced that an ice cream and frozen desserts distributor has selected its Touchless Retail™ APEX Merchandising team to perform in-store freezer resets, helping ensure products are properly positioned, organized and available to consumers.


Frozen dessert resets present unique merchandising challenges, requiring precise product placement, adherence to planograms and efficient execution within temperature-sensitive retail environments. With limited freezer space, expanding product assortments and seasonal demand fluctuations, effective reset execution is critical to maximizing product availability and sales opportunities.


Touchless Retail provides a fundamentally different approach to merchandising by combining much lower costs with superior execution. Its fixed-cost model is typically 50% less expensive than traditional hourly merchandising services, while its APEX Merchandising team consists exclusively of the top 10% of merchandising professionals, selected for their demonstrated performance and reliability.


The APEX team delivers a 99%+ on-time and show-up rate with less than 0.5% rework, providing suppliers with predictable costs, consistent execution and greater confidence that merchandising activities will be completed correctly the first time.


“Frozen categories are particularly demanding because every inch of freezer space matters, and execution directly impacts product availability and sales,” said Randy Fields, chairman and CEO of ReposiTrak. “This distributor is choosing a better way to execute store resets—using only the industry’s best merchandisers at approximately half the traditional cost. That’s a powerful combination of quality and economics that changes what suppliers should expect from merchandising services.”


Through Touchless Retail, the distributor will leverage APEX Merchandising professionals from SPAR Group to execute freezer resets, including product repositioning, planogram compliance, shelf organization and preparation of freezer displays for changing product assortments.


The program reflects growing supplier interest in merchandising solutions that replace unpredictable hourly labor costs with fixed-cost execution and measurable performance standards.


“Suppliers shouldn’t have to choose between lower merchandising costs and better execution,” Fields added. “With Touchless Retail, they can have both.”


**About ReposiTrak** ReposiTrak, Inc. (NYSE: TRAK) is an AI-powered, integrated platform that connects retailers, wholesalers, suppliers, and food manufacturers through a suite of applications designed to reduce risk, support regulatory compliance, strengthen operational controls, and protect brand integrity. The ReposiTrak platform serves as a shared system of record across its solution areas, maintaining and synchronizing complex supplier and customer data to enable secure, accurate, and scalable information exchange.


ReposiTrak’s solutions are organized into three core product families: traceability, compliance and risk management, and supply chain solutions. Through its scalable, cloud-based platform and U.S.-based team of experts, the Company helps organizations streamline operations, improve data transparency, and meet evolving regulatory requirements across the food supply chain.


For more information, visit[www.repositrak.com](https://www.repositrak.com/) .


**About SPAR Group** SPAR Group is a merchandising and retail services company providing in-store merchandising, product resets, remodels, and other retail execution services. Its field teams support retailers and consumer brands in improving product presentation, implementing merchandising programs, and maintaining consistent execution across retail locations.


For more information, visit[www.sparinc.com](http://www.sparinc.com/) .
